svg.title: Diagram commands address review slides
svg.desc: describe, get, edit, check, and visual-qa find a review slide by --review or its URN; partial writers refuse transaction-managed review slides.

text.tspan: One resolver lets every slide command reach a review slide
and point at diagram describe, diagram edit, and apply-slide --review
